name: Chicken Tikka Masala with Basmati Rice

components.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
steps: Marinate chicken with yogurt, spices, aromatics and oil for at least 8 hours under refrigeration for best results.
In a hot skillet, brown chicken pieces in batches until nearly cooked, then reserve.
In a saucepan, heat sauce oil; cook onions to deep golden, add chilli and ginger-garlic, and briefly toast powdered spices.
Add tomato puree and simmer until thick and aromatic. Use the measured water to adjust consistency.
Stir in cream and fenugreek, return chicken and simmer gently until chicken reaches at least 74°C; garnish with coriander.
Pack tikka sauce with chicken separately from rice for reheating; avoid vigorous boiling of sauce.

components.name: Basmati Rice
steps: Cook basmati separately in a covered pot and leave to rest before fluffing.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Adapted from source using the stovetop skillet option and adding 360g dry basmati rice. Source marination 8+ hours. Sauce uses cream version (not cashew version).
Storing & reheating: Freeze sauce and basmati separately; stir slowly while reheating.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
